limitations: Only a real symmetric positive-definite spectral interval, one-dimensional sketched Ritz, row subset based on the trial vector alone, exact arithmetic, and ideal top-s selection for budgets greater than one. Not a multi-Ritz or floating-point result.
scientific_integrity: The exact universal bounds are proved analytically; finite tests are supplementary. Classical two-sided quotient and row-selection constructions are credited, and independent originality validation has not been performed.
title: Sharp deterministic row-sampling budget for positivity of a one-vector sketched Ritz value
